tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Read-only catalog of the datasets on this server. Returns one row per dataset with `id` (the value other tools accept as `dataset`), `title`, `kind`, `tools` (number of products), `plans` (number of plans), `updated` (date of the last verified change), `page` URL and `json` endpoint on getstackversu

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Read-only list of the products (vendors) covered, to look up ids before calling get_tool or compare_tools. Returns `count` and `tools`, each with `id`, `name`, `vendor`, `dataset`, `checked` (date the vendor page was last read), `plans` (count) and `page` URL; no prices or limits, those live in get_

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Read-only full verified record for one product. Returns `matches` and up to 3 `records`; each record has `dataset`, `plans` (name, monthly and annual price, metering unit, limits per window), `rates` (per-unit prices such as $/min or $/1M tokens, each with the vendor `quote`), `free` tier, `overage`

tools.name: search_limits
tools.description: Read-only keyword search across every plan, limit, rate, free tier, overage rule and gotcha in all datasets. Best first call for a question like "Cursor Pro requests per month", "Retell cost per minute" or "Gemini API free tier RPM". Returns `query`, `relaxed` (true when fewer than all words matched

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Read-only compact comparison of 2 to 6 products. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_tools" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read-only list of the products (vendors) covered, to look up ids before calling get_tool or compare_tools. Returns `count` and `tools`, each with `id`, `name`, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_datasets, list_tools, get_tool, list_changes · Private data: list_datasets, get_tool, compare_tools · Public sink: list_datasets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_datasets, list_tools, get_tool, list_changes · Private data: list_datasets, get_tool, compare_tools · Public sink: list_datasets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
